summary.text: Josh Bashline is a Republican state representative who was elected in 2024 to represent Pennsylvania House District 63, which covers all of Clarion County and parts of Armstrong County, and he is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a 12-year veteran of the Pennsylvania National Guard.

paragraphs.text: Bashline is a graduate of Edinboro University and the Dale Carnegie Leadership Development Program, according to his official biography.
He served 12 years in the Pennsylvania National Guard, including an overseas deployment, and worked as a state House member's district office manager before his own election.

For the 2025-26 session he serves on the House Environmental and Natural Resources Protection; Housing and Community Development; Human Services; and Veterans Affairs and Emergency Preparedness committees.

His biography lists his priorities as supporting local jobs and small businesses, border security, American energy independence, voter ID, parental control over education, and Second Amendment rights.
Democrat Andrew Harbaugh is his opponent in the general election, according to Ballotpedia.
